files.reason: This lane's local checks for run_checks.py: the changed and new test modules (test_mode_binding, test_freeze_gates_fix, test_rehearsals) and lint_language over the two bound review files.

Lane freeze-gates-fix (glitch-f1's ruling (2) of Wed 21 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation; lane-reports/freeze-gates-fix-LANE.md) fixes six freeze-path checks already red at the accepted head 5457e75e, on the line with all 225 walks merged (dry/all-225, d5c0f798). Edits without transfer, recorded here only so the owners' fragments stay untouched: mode_binding.py (w8a-walk-layout), the pin compared with the record each harness writes (Codex: the rollout turn_context's approval_policy and sandbox_policy; Gemini: the launch argv, input side, since Gemini 0.64.0 writes no mode record); fixture_walk.py (w8a-walk-layout), run_tree_of reads the launch journals' cwd when the ledger has none; walk_regrade.py (live-harness-foundation), an absent nested_cli_calls key compared only as a derived 0; language-allowlist.json (w1a-cp1-scaffold), four excusals for the hash-bound native-readers/codex-review.md and gemini-review.md; tests/test_mode_binding.py (w7b-walk-wiring), M4-vendor and two witnesses; tests/test_rehearsals.py (w7d-rehearsals), R4.empty's committed-register leg reads the registered state; tests/test_build_draft.py (w5c-draft-ci), R9.sessions reads the registered sessions. S8 (glitch-f1's rulings on the lane's hand-back, 21 Oct 2026): fixture_walk.py (w8a-walk-layout), RECORDED_EXCEPTIONS, w023's one per-walk exception, printed whenever it applies; tests/test_box_integration.py (w7b-walk-wiring), the production native-reader registry read hermetically under the process guard (a call naming no study, or the study tree, reads an empty scratch study); tests/test_native_history_record.py and tests/test_native_reader_registration.py (live-harness-foundation) and tests/test_vendor_admission.py (vendor-admission), their pre-acceptance expectations moved to the registered state at 5457e75e (both readers registered, Javier's acceptance commit the last on each record), each unregistered road still asserted through a registry without the harness. prereg-draft.json (w8b-holdout-digests) is re-derived by build_draft.py in its own commit and carries no note. allowlist-derivation.json stays an identical copy: its difference is round 4's prior round, not a new input (reported to glitch-f1).
